name: odometer
title: Odometer
description: A number on mechanical digit wheels that roll to their new faces whenever the value changes. Formats with Intl, so currency and grouping just work.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to show. When it changes, each digit wheel rolls to its new face.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the number.

props.name: format
props.description: Intl.NumberFormat options: currency, grouping, decimals and so on.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds a wheel takes to roll.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between wheels, from the last digit to the first.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off so the number jumps.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
